title: Snowy Hub | Silent Aim, Auto Kill, Rapidfire & More
features:
Silent Aim – Redirects shots toward selected targets without visibly moving the camera.

Auto Shoot – Automatically fires at valid targets.

Auto Kill All – Automatically targets and eliminates players or bots.

Rapid Fire – Increases the firing rate of supported weapons.

Wallbang (RISKY) – Allows shots to hit targets through certain walls or obstacles.

Humanized Aimbot – Provides smoother, more natural-looking aim assistance.

Triggerbot – Automatically fires when an enemy enters the crosshair.

Player & Bot ESP – Highlights players and bots for easier tracking.

Customizable FOV – Adjusts the field of view used for targeting.

Visibility & Target Filters – Filters targets based on visibility and other conditions.

Auto Claim Rewards – Automatically claims available rewards.

Performance Optimization – Provides settings designed to improve game performance.
